title: "Structure"
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true
    comment: "#>"
---

Each WiGiTS tool has a single `schema.yaml` under `inst/config/tools/<tool>/`.
See <https://tidywf.github.io/nemo/articles/structure.html> for a walkthrough of
the `Tool`/`Workflow`/`Config` class structure and schema contents.

## Fan-out

Some files split into several output tables, declared under `outputs` in their
tool's `schema.yaml` and written as `<prefix>_<tool>_<output>`:

```{r}
#| label: fanout
#| echo: false

use("tidywigits", "WIGITS_TOOLS")
names(WIGITS_TOOLS) |>
  purrr::map(\(tool) {
    nemo::Config$new(tool, pkg = "tidywigits")$get_outputs() |>
      dplyr::mutate(tool = tool, .before = 1)
  }) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$name != .data$table) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    outputs = paste0("`", .data$name, "`", collapse = ", "),
    .by = c("tool", "table")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(table = paste0("`", .data$table, "`")) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Tool", "File table", "Outputs"))
```
